pooling_policy: Strictly per-dataset reporting; never pool screening (NLBS) with diagnostic/mixed (IMDB/CMMD/LUMINA).

nlbs.selection_bias_caveat: Organized provincial screening cohort; 6,359 unique StudyInstanceUIDs (6,184 4-view, 151 pos).
nlbs.license: FRDR Restricted / Academic Research Use (already downloaded & verified)

cmmd.selection_bias_caveat: 100% biopsy-confirmed benign/malignant diagnostic cohort (~74% malignant). 826/1775 bilateral 4-view; 949/1775 unilateral 2-view. No population dismissal claims.
